defs.d: An act or instance of asking.
Something asked or asked for.
defs.ex: I know this is a big ask, but …

defs.d: To request (information, or an answer to a question).
defs.ex: I asked her age.

defs.d: To put forward (a question) to be answered.
defs.ex: to ask a question

defs.d: Food that is prepared and eaten, usually at a specific time, and usually in a comparatively large quantity (as opposed to a snack).
defs.ex: Breakfast is the morning meal, lunch is the noon meal, and dinner, or supper, is the evening meal.

defs.d: Food served or eaten as a repast.
The act of moving to a lower position under the effect of gravity.
A reduction in quantity, pitch, etc.
(heading) To be moved downwards.
To move downwards.
Capacity to do something well; technique, ability. Skills are usually acquired or learned, as opposed to abilities, which are often thought of as innate.
Discrimination; judgment; propriety; reason; cause.
Great, excellent.
Subject; theme; a category or general area of interest.
defs.ex: A society where a topic cannot be discussed, does not have free speech.

defs.d: Discussion thread.
Topical
Very bad.
defs.ex: My socks smell awful.

defs.d: Exceedingly great; usually applied intensively.
defs.ex: I have learnt an awful amount today.

defs.d: Awfully; dreadfully; terribly.
Very, extremely.
defs.ex: He was blubbering away something awful.

defs.d: A piece of metal placed in a horse's mouth and connected to the reins to direct the animal.
defs.ex: A horse hates having a bit put in its mouth.

defs.d: A rotary cutting tool fitted to a drill, used to bore holes.
To put a bridle upon; to put the bit in the mouth of (a horse).
A situation which allows a mutually exclusive choice between two or more possibilities; a choice between two or more possibilities.
One of several mutually exclusive things which can be chosen.
Relating to a choice between two or more possibilities.
defs.ex: an alternative proposition

defs.d: Other; different from something else.
A lid.
Area or situation which screens a person or thing from view.
defs.ex: The soldiers took cover behind a ruined building.

defs.d: To place something over or upon, as to conceal or protect.
defs.ex: He covered the baby with a blanket.

defs.d: To be over or upon, as to conceal or protect.
defs.ex: The blanket covered the baby.

defs.d: Of or pertaining to the front cover of a book or magazine.
Of, pertaining to, or consisting of cover versions.
A doer, maker; a person who does things for another person or organization.
defs.ex: The factor of the trading post bought the furs.

defs.d: An agent or representative.
To find all the factors of (a number or other mathematical object) (the objects that divide it evenly).
(of a number or other mathematical object) To be a product of other objects.
A perfect standard of beauty, intellect etc., or a standard of excellence to aim at.
A subring closed under multiplication by its containing ring.
Optimal; being the best possibility.
Perfect, flawless, having no defects.
To arrange in working order.
To constitute in parts, each having a special function, act, office, or relation; to systematize.

A fundamental, generic term used when referring to the measurement (count, amount) of a scalar, vector, number of items or to some other way of denominating the value of a collection or group of items.
defs.ex: You have to choose between quantity and quality.

defs.d: An indefinite amount of something.
defs.ex: Olive oil can be used practically in any quantity.

defs.d: A disk, usually made of a polymer, used to record sound for playback on a phonograph.
An item of information put into a temporary or permanent physical medium.
defs.ex: The person had a record of the interview so she could review her notes.

defs.d: Any instance of a physical medium on which information was put for the purpose of preserving it and making it available for future reference.
defs.ex: We have no record of you making this payment to us.

defs.d: A series of events which produce a result (the product).
defs.ex: This product of last month's quality standards committee is quite good, even though the process was flawed.

defs.d: A set of procedures used to produce a product, most commonly in the food and chemical industries.
defs.ex: 1960, Mack Tyner, Process Engineering Calculations: Material and Energy Balances – Ordinarily a process plant will use a steam boiler to supply its process heat requirements and to drive a steam-turbine generator.

defs.d: To perform a particular process on a thing.
To retrieve, store, classify, manipulate, transmit etc. (data, signals, etc.), especially using computer techniques.
defs.ex: We have processed the data using our proven techniques, and have come to the following conclusions.

defs.d: One who uses or makes use of something, a consumer/client or an express or implied licensee (free user) or a trespasser.
A person who uses drugs, especially illegal drugs.
A black rock formed from prehistoric plant remains, composed largely of carbon and burned as a fuel.
defs.ex: Put some coal on the fire.

defs.d: A piece of coal used for burning (this use is less common in American English)
defs.ex: Put some coals on the fire.

defs.d: To take on a supply of coal (usually of steam ships).
To supply with coal.
defs.ex: to coal a steamer

defs.d: A percussive instrument made of metal or other hard material, typically but not always in the shape of an inverted cup with a flared rim, which resonates when struck.
The sounding of a bell as a signal.
To attach a bell to.
defs.ex: Who will bell the cat?

defs.d: To shape so that it flares out like a bell.
defs.ex: to bell a tube

defs.d: To cause one to experience a memory (of someone or something); to bring to the notice or consideration (of a person).
The act of spreading.
Something that has been spread.
To stretch out, open out (a material etc.) so that it more fully covers a given area of space.
defs.ex: He spread his newspaper on the table.

defs.d: To extend (individual rays, limbs etc.); to stretch out in varying or opposing directions.
defs.ex: I spread my arms wide and welcomed him home.

defs.d: A wide, flat receptacle used around the house, especially for cooking.
The contents of such a receptacle.
To wash in a pan (of earth, sand etc. when searching for gold).
To disparage; to belittle; to put down; to criticise severely.
Meanings relating to a wind instrument.
Meanings relating to a hollow conduit.
A leader or head of a group of people, organisation, etc.
defs.ex: All firefighters report to the fire chief.

defs.d: The top part of a shield or escutcheon; more specifically, an ordinary consisting of the upper part of the field cut off by a horizontal line, generally occupying the top third.
To smoke cannabis.
Primary; principal.
defs.ex: Negligence was the chief cause of the disaster.

defs.d: Intimate, friendly.

An annual publication; a book, periodical, journal, report, comic book, yearbook, etc., which is published serially once a year, which may or may not be in addition to regular weekly or monthly publication.
defs.ex: I read the magazine, but I usually don't purchase the annuals.

defs.d: An annual plant; a plant with a life span of just one growing season; a plant which naturally germinates, flowers and dies in one year. Compare biennial, perennial.
defs.ex: I can't wait to plant my annuals in the spring.

defs.d: Happening once every year.
defs.ex: an annual general meeting;  an annual publication

defs.d: Of, for, or relating to a whole year, often as a recurring cycle; determined or reckoned by the year; accumulating in the course of a year; performed, executed, or completed over the course of a year. See also circannual.
defs.ex: an annual salary;  average annual profits;  the annual course of the sun

defs.d: That which is independent of context-dependent interpretation, inviolate, fundamental.
defs.ex: moral absolutes

defs.d: Anything that is absolute.
Free of restrictions, limitations, qualifications or conditions; unconditional.
defs.ex: 1658, Samuel Hoard, God[']s Love to Mankind, Manifested, by disprooving his absolute decree for their damnation

defs.d: Free from imperfection, perfect, complete; especially, perfectly embodying a quality in its essential characteristics or to its highest degree.
defs.ex: absolute purity, absolute liberty

defs.d: To encounter or discover by accident; to happen upon.
To encounter or discover something being searched for; to locate.
defs.ex: I found my car keys. They were under the couch.

defs.d: A result of research or an investigation.
A formal conclusion by a judge, jury or regulatory agency on issues of fact.
To divide into portions and dispense.
defs.ex: He distributed the bread amongst his followers.

defs.d: To supply to retail outlets.
defs.ex: The agency distributes newspapers to local shops.

defs.d: (19th-mid 20th century) An employee in industry.
An enterprise producing tangible goods or providing certain services to industrial companies.
Of or relating to industry, notably manufacturing.
defs.ex: The industrial segment of the economy has seen troubles lately.

defs.d: Produced by such industry.
defs.ex: Handicraft is less standardized then industrial products, hence less artistic or rather flawless.

defs.d: One who participates.
defs.ex: All participants must adhere to the rules of the competition.

defs.d: Sharing; participating; having a share of part.
